description:
Full sourced record for one agent harness by slug.
Use when: you have a harness slug and need its sources, caveats, pricing or feature evidence.
Do not use for: listing or filtering harnesses (list_harnesses).
Returns: the harness with source URLs, dated checks (pricing, features, stars, last_checked) and related Vibe Shipped pages; or isError not_found.
Limits: Slugs come from list_harnesses.
Example: {"slug":"openai-codex-cli"}

slug.description: Harness slug, e.g. claude-code, openai-codex-cli, aider, langgraph.

name: get_harness
title: Get one agent harness
